Jamaica to Petition King Charles for Slavery Reparations

A Jamaican minister is set to present a petition to King Charles III requesting reparations for slavery. The petition asks the King to refer three specific questions regarding reparations to the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council. This action signifies Jamaica's formal request for the British monarchy to address historical injustices related to the transatlantic slave trade.
